જય સ્વામિનારાયણ

Opening the vatos… The first visit takes a few seconds; after that it opens straight away, even offline.

Prakarans 1 to 7 (Gujarati, English translation, transliteration and footnotes) are from the 7-prakaran edition of Swami Ni Vaato. Prakarans 8 to 16 and the word meanings are from the 16-prakaran edition; prakarans 8 to 16 are in Gujarati only.

The feeling lists and the Seva, Life as a householder and Hard words lists are a personal selection made after reading the 1,484 vatos of the 7-prakaran edition. The original editions give prakarans 8 to 16 no topics; they are being tagged for this site, prakaran by prakaran. Vatos without a topic can be found through search or by prakaran.

After your first visit this site works offline, and it can be added to your home screen like an app. Saved vatos, text size and theme stay on this device only; nothing is sent anywhere.
